Potential energies are only associated with conservative forces. The change in potential energy between two configurations of a system is the negative of the work done by the conservative force during the change. Because the gravitational field near the surface of a planet is nearly constant, the change in gravitational potential energy of a system containing an object and a planet when the object is near the surface of the planet can be approximated by ΔU_g = mgΔy.
